name: belt
description: A belt with a broad rectangular buckle and a visible fastening prong.
useCase: Identify belts or waist accessories in a clothing catalogue.
misuse: Use a visible label when clothing identifies a product, size or dress requirement.

16.reason: The buckle stays open around its short fastening prong.

24.reason: The larger belt retains a complete buckle and a clear fastening prong.
